detail.title: CP-UNR-4K5324-FI
features: Up to 32 channel IP camera input
Max. 384 Mbps Incoming/ Recording/ Outgoing bandwidth
Instastream, H.265, H.264+, H.264, MJPEG codec decoding
AI by recorder: 2 Channel face detection and recognition, up to 20 face                                databases and 20,000 face images, 4 Channel perimeter protection,  8 Channel IMD+
AI by camera: Face detection and recognition, Perimeter protection,  IMD+, Metadata, ANPR, Stereo analysis, Heat map, People counting
Support 4 SATA HDDs up to 20TB Each, 3 USB Ports (1 front USB 2.0 port, 2 rear USB 3.0 ports)
2 HDMI/ 2 VGA Heterogeneous, simultaneous video output

General.Video Output: 2 VGA:1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720        2 HDMI:3840 × 2160, 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720   Heterogeneous video source output for HDMI1 and HDMI2     Simultaneous video source output for VGA1 and HDMI1       Simultaneous video source output for VGA2 and HDMI2
General.Decoding Capability: AI disabled: 2 Channel 32 MP@25 fps, 2 Channel 24 MP@25 fps, 4 Channel 16 MP@30 fps, 5  Channel 12 MP@30 fps, 8 Channel 8 MP@30 fps, 10 Channel 6 MP@30 fps, 12 Channel 5  MP@30 fps, 16 Channel 4 MP@30 fps, 32 Channel 1080p@30 fps       AI enabled: 1 Channel 32 MP@25 fps; 1 Channel 24 MP@25 fps; 2 Channel 16 MP@30 fps, 4  Channel 12 MP@30 fps, 6 Channel 8 MP@30 fps, 8 Channel 6 MP@30 fps, 8 Channel 5  MP@30 fps, 12 Channel 4 MP@30 fps, 24 Channel 1080p@30 fps
General.AI by NVR: Face detection, Face recognition, Perimeter protection, IMD+
General.AI by Camera: Face detection, Face recognition, Video metadata (Human, Motor vehicles, Non-motor vehi cles), Perimeter protection, IMD+, Stereo analysis, Crowd distribution, People counting,  ANPR, Vehicle density, Heat map
General.IntelliCheck AI by Camera + Recorder: Max. 32 Channel, 1 combined event per Channel/s
General.Resolution: 32 MP, 24 MP, 16 MP, 12 MP, 8 MP, 6 MP, 5 MP, 4 MP, 2 MP, 720p, 960p, D1, CIF, QCIF
General.Network Bandwidth: AI disabled: 384 Mbps incoming, 384 Mbps recording and 384 Mbps outgoing  AI enabled: 200 Mbps incoming, 200 Mbps recording and 200 Mbps outgoing
General.Perimeter Performance AI by NVR (Number: 4 Channels, 10 IVS rules for each Channel
General.Perimeter Performance of AI by Camera (N: Human and vehicle detection on all channels, supporting up to 16 targets per second
General.Face Attributes: Gender, Age group, Glasses, Expressions, Face mask, Beard
General.Face Detection Performance of AI by Reco: 2 Channels (up to 12 face images/s each Channel)
General.Face Database Capacity: Up to 20 face databases with 20,000 images, with a total capacity of 2.5 G. Name, gender,  birthday, address, credential type, credential No., countries & regions and state can be added  to each face image
General.Face Recognition Performance of AI by NV: 1.16 Channel FD (by camera) + FR (by NVR), image stream: 16 face images/s 2.2 Channel FD (by NVR) + FR (by NVR), video stream: 12 face images/s
General.IMD+ by NVR: 8 Channels: Secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle, reducing false alarms caused by  leaves, rain and lighting condition change
General.IMD+ by Camera: Human and vehicle detection on all channels, supporting up to 32 targets per second
General.Human Attributes: Top color, Top type, Bottom color, Bottom type, Hat, Bag, age, Gender and Umbrella
General.Motor Vehicle Attributes: License plate, plate color, vehicle body, vehicle model, vehicle logo, calling, seatbelt, vehicle  interior, vehicle registration location
General.Non-motor Vehicle Attributes: Vehicle model, Vehicle color, Number of persons, Helmet
General.License Plate Database Capacity: 1. Create up to 20,000 plate numbers  2. Blocklist and allowlist
General.Abnormality Alarm: Camera offline, Storage error, Disk full, IP conflict, MAC conflict, Login lock, Abnormal  behaviour of fan, Cyber security exception
General.Intelligent Alarm: Face detection, Perimeter protection, Face recognition, Video metadata (Human, Motor   vehicles, Non-motor vehicles), IMD+, Stereo analysis, Crowd distribution, People counting,  ANPR, Vehicle density, Heat map
General.General Alarm: Motion detection, Local alarm, Alarm box, Camera external alarm, Network alarm, Scene  changing, PIR alarm, Thermal alarm
General.Alarm Linkage: Record, Snapshot (panoramic), Local alarm output, IPC external alarm output, Access control ler, Audio, Buzzer, Log, Preset, Email
General.Hard Disk: 4 SATA ports, each disk can contain up to 20 TB. This limit varies depending on the environment temperature
General.Record Mode: General, Motion detection, Intelligent, Alarm, POS
General.Playback Mode: Instant playback, General playback, Event playback, Tag playback, Smart playback (face and  motion detection)
General.Interface Ports: 3 USB (1 front USB 2.0 port, 2 rear USB 3.0 ports), 1 RS232, 1 eSATA Port, 1 RS485 (half-duplex  serial communication)
General.Protocols: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP/IP, IPv4, UDP, NTP, DHCP, DNS, SMTP, UPnP, DDNS, Alarm Server, Multicast,  InstaOn, Auto Connect, iSCSI, ONVIF (Profile T, Profile S, Profile G), CGI, SDK
General.Network Mode: Multi-address mode, Load balance, Fault tolerance and other network port binding modes
General.Power Consumption: Total output of NVR is ≤ 13 W (without HDD)
